name: newspaper
description: A classic newspaper layout — serif headlines, bold masthead accent, left sidebar.
author: Mortar Team
custom_css: body { background: #fefcf9; } article h2 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } article { border-bottom: 2px solid #1c1917 !important; } aside h3 { font-family: Georgia, serif; border-bottom: 3px double #1c1917; padding-bottom: 6px; } .masthead { font-family: Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
